newsitem.title: USA: Shell expects downstream talks to end June.
newsitem.headline: Shell expects downstream talks to end June.

text.p: Shell Oil Co expects to finalise details of the part of its downstream venture with Texaco Inc which involves Saudi Refining Inc this month.
A spokeswoman for the Royal Dutch/Shell Group said that the with Saudi Refining talks were on target for completion.

Texaco and Shell agreed the terms of their downstream U.S. merger in March this year, but discussions with Saudi Refining, Texaco's joint venture partner in Star Enterprise in the eastern U.S., has held up the process.
Star operates three refineries and accounts for 600,000 barrels per day out of the 2.2 million barrels per day from the total Shell, Texaco, Star venture.
The Star refineries provided Saudi Arabia with an outlet for crude oil under a 20 year agreement signed in 1988 after Texaco emerged from bankruptcy and a restructuring.
Star is also the sixth largest branded gasoline retailer in the U.S.
A spokeswoman for Texaco confirmed that the companies would make an announcement before the end of this month. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
